title.de: little india im lichterglanz zu deepavali.

line.en: deepavali is sunday 8 nov, monday 9 is the holiday in lieu. the serangoon road lights come on from 7pm and the festival village bazaar runs to 8 nov; walk it after dark.
line.de: deepavali ist sonntag, 8. nov, montag, 9. nov ist der ersatzfeiertag. die lichter in der serangoon road gehen ab 19 uhr an, der festival village bazaar läuft bis 8. nov; nach einbruch der dunkelheit hingehen.
line.tr: deepavali pazar, 8 kasım; pazartesi 9 kasım telafi tatili. serangoon road ışıkları 19:00'da yanıyor, festival village pazarı 8 kasıma kadar açık; hava kararınca yürü.

sparks.why: Deepavali on sun 8 nov with mon 9 nov in lieu (MOM list, via Circles.Life and officeholidays); the Little India light-up runs nightly from 7pm and the Festival Village bazaar to 8 nov, per radicalstorage and littlebigreddot guides.
